title: Somewhat Disappointed
text:
Somewhat Disappointed. Actually looks pretty plain once you look at it in person.
Nowhere near as impressive as in the picture.
Got to admit I am disappointed in this one.
3 Stars because it is a functional mug but that's pretty much it.
